Photorealistic straight-on photograph of a modern convenience-store shopfront at night in a Chinese city. Seen from the sidewalk at eye level, frontal elevation with minimal perspective distortion, portrait framing. Behind large clear glass: a brightly lit interior with a white ceiling of square LED panels, a long refrigerated drinks wall filled with rows of colourful bottles and cans, snack shelves, a checkout counter, and one shopper in a dark coat seen from behind. Warm 4000K interior light spilling out, cool blue street light reflected on the glass, fine rain droplets and faint vertical streaks on the window, thin dark aluminium mullions. Subtle interior haze, restrained lens bloom, realistic materials, natural colour, 35mm architectural photograph. No readable text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, nobody facing the camera.
